paragraphs: Rav Mari, son of Rav Ashi.
Mentioned in [Bava Metzia 103a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.103a.7), but Dikdukei Soferim and the Rosh read “Rav Ashi said,” which Hyman considers more correct.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Rav Mari son of Rav Ashi is the speaker in the linked Bavli.
The [Rosh](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Bava_Metzia.8.33.1) attributes the statement to Rav Ashi himself, as [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2401&lang=en) also notes.
Hyman prefers the Rav Ashi reading and reports it from Dikdukei Soferim as well.
